# The Rig Doctor

> The Rig Doctor is a custom pedalboard builder based in the Houston, Texas area that ships across the United States. Rig builders Mason Marangella and Vince DiGioia have hand-built 300+ pedalboards over 17 years for touring artists, session players, worship guitarists and home players. Every custom build starts with a free 30-minute consultation.

## Services

- [Custom pedalboard builds](https://www.therigdr.com/custom-builds): Planned on a free call, diagrammed, quoted, then hand-built with hand-soldered Mogami cable cut to length, isolated power and clean switching. Builds start at $1,999 USD and usually take 4 to 8 weeks. Lifetime support on every build. Customers ship their pedals in; finished rigs ship back insured to all 50 US states. International shipping is case by case.
- [Tone Tutoring](https://www.therigdr.com/tone-tutoring): A 60-minute one-on-one video session for $99 USD. We go through a player's whole signal chain, amp settings and pedal order, and fix noise and tone problems with them.
- [Free build consultation](https://www.therigdr.com/book): A 30-minute call to talk through a rig, goals and what a build would cost.
- [Shop](https://www.therigdr.com/shop): The cables, power and parts we use on our own builds.
- [Pricing](https://www.therigdr.com/pricing) and [our build process](https://www.therigdr.com/process).

## The builders

- Mason Marangella, Rig Builder: founded Vertex Effects and built the Vertex by Gator pedalboard series. Has built rigs for Andy Timmons, Oz Noy, Michael Landau, Kirk Fletcher, Josh Smith and Matt Schofield.
- Vince DiGioia, Rig Builder: plays lead guitar with 35 Drive and has toured with Roger Creager, Josh Abbott Band, Reckless Kelly and Pat Green. Runs Tone Tutoring sessions.
- [About The Rig Doctor](https://www.therigdr.com/about)
